meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

copy.tagline: 自动化浏览器交互与网页测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码操控浏览器并验证网页行为
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and test web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically and verify web page behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过命令行控制浏览器:打开网页、点击、输入、填表、截图、录视频、管理标签页/Cookie/存储、模拟网络请求,也能运行和调试 Playwright 测试,并在每步操作后给出页面快照。
howto.when: 当用户要求操作浏览器、测试网页或处理 Playwright 测试时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,点击“登录”按钮并截图
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器并执行这些操作。

say.text: 运行项目里的 Playwright 测试并汇总失败原因
say.note: 会调用 playwright-cli 执行测试。

say.text: 录制当前页面的操作视频,标注每个动作
say.note: 会启动视频录制并添加动作标注。

howto.what_en: Claude can drive a browser via CLI: open pages, click, type, fill forms, screenshot, record video, manage tabs/cookies/storage, mock network requests, run/debug Playwright tests. Each command returns a snapshot of the current page.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to operate a browser, test a web page, or work with Playwright tests.

say_en.text: Open example.com, click the “Sign in” button, and screenshot it.
say_en.note: Claude launches a browser and performs the steps.

say_en.text: Run the Playwright tests in the project and summarize failures.
say_en.note: This invokes playwright-cli to run the tests.

say_en.text: Record a video of the current page and annotate each action.
say_en.note: Starts video recording and adds action callouts.
